cells.quote: "Results of quantitative analyses showed that IXL Math had a statistically significant positive impact on student mathematics achievement after one semester, with IXL Math students outgaining control students on the EOY Renaissance Star Math by 10 points (effect size = +0.13)."
cells.note: No study text is available; this quote is copied from the wiki entry, so all study attributes and the effect are coded as unknown.

cells.quote: Additionally, students were tested on the M-STEP, and the IXL impact was positive but not statistically significant (effect size = +0.03).
